concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-stored-value-api-merge-balance]] — 2026-09-15-captured Stored Value API full-balance merge guide for same-provider cards, Fiserv online-only matrix scope, tokenized target and response fields.
warnings: Online provider matrix checks only Fiserv/ValueLink and in-person matrix checks none; optional store and POS enum do not establish in-person support.
Tokenized example uses a card-number-looking recurringDetailReference; field description calls for a token returned at tokenization.
currentBalance response text does not identify source versus target card; do not assign it without further authority.
